description: ADDED IN REVIEW. A candidate that fails ALTERNATIVE SELECTION rather than placeholder resolution. en-001's Article has no top-level translation, only a single alternative guarded by 'count == 1', and the phonetic placeholder is declared alongside it. When the predicate holds the placeholder is evaluated and the resolver is handed en-001; when it does not, the candidate ends in NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE and the resolver is never reached at that candidate at all — the two cases differ only in the value of count, which makes the absence falsifiable rather than vacuous. Under any-failure the walk then reaches en. Tiebreakers are mandatory: en and en-001 share a language code.
